2. Template 1914396 applied to A gave precursors C = Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=O)cc2)cc1 and D = O=C(O)CC(=O)O.
3. The remaining fragment C still contains the sulfonyl‑aryl core that can be disconnected by template 733. We verify that template 733 matches C and then apply it to obtain the final building blocks.

The route therefore satisfies the required order and contains at least three reactions.</thought>
